scope: Source-only mathematical and reference-evidence review; no builds, numerical execution, new certificates, or benchmark claims

checks.routing: Displayed lexicographic distances match q0=0 and Cartesian axis shifts with lengths 1,2,3,4 in metric (+---). All ten are nonzero; four shifts are independent.
checks.normalization: E6=-integral_Delta4 F^-2 and volume=1/24 agree with independent existing E6 oracle. This is a five-parameter, four-dimensional simplex.
checks.tail_preflight: 1015/8<128 and L>2 imply eta*B(1,1)/L<2^-58. For 0<=r<1/2, H4(r)=r^5*(5/(1-r)+1/(1-r)^2)<14*r^5. Thus H4(2^-58)/96<2^-290<2^-256. Positive coefficientwise majorization bounds every requested component by this common preflight bound. Future execution must emit and check exact individual radii.
checks.independence: Vacuum coefficients derive from differentiating the unexpanded physical parameter integrand and have zero remainder. The nonzero-row oracle integrates order four about M with an independent positive tail; candidate N2 freezes m0=M-2eta. No candidate integrated polynomial or bound helper is reused.
checks.rectangle_gate: Numeric and worst candidate-corner coordinate distances to the oracle center enlarged by its complex-modulus radius give conservative exact squared distance bounds. Complete oracle coordinate-interval containment is an additional explicit requirement; mere intersection is insufficient.
checks.accuracy_gate: Conditional on the proposed exact gates, true nonprimal magnitude >=eta/2^15 and absolute allowed error eta*2^-96 imply relative error <=2^-81. The new absolute budgets 2^-160 strengthen the old uniform2^-128 budgets. Actual allowed_error_squared must equal2^-320 on these nonprimal rows and is checked from the emitted returned value and relative budget.
checks.batch_counts: Five scale-valid packed rows, four analytically active rows, three successful rows and two hidden failures are consistent source expectations. They remain unobserved until execution; rejected rows and components may not be excluded.
checks.original_iregi: Read si_reduce.f90 matrix entry point and both real D6 shortcuts, csi_reduce.f90 complex shortcut, reference driver scalar/general protocols, shifted-pentagon adjudication source and recorded disagreement. These support treating original IREGI D6 results as diagnostic, not the independent correctness oracle here.
checks.derivative_identity: Read ignored second-order public-core identity test at crates/iregi-rust/tests/shifted_pentagon.rs:196-217. The separate first-derivative master test is not ignored; the revised note correctly identifies the higher-derivative test.
checks.reuse_and_caps: Available Symbolica differentiation, series, Q polynomial integration, endpoint substitution and exact evaluation cover the required algebra. Current quadrature successive-order estimates do not supply certified component tails. Runtime/term limits and fixed source evidence are requirements, not measured successes. A post-conversion term cap alone does not prevent memory exhaustion during conversion.

wording_refinements_verified: Heading identifies heterogeneous higher jets rather than implying five differential axes; there are two jet axes.
Five-parameter simplex wording replaces ambiguous five-simplex wording.
Ignored higher-derivative test has its exact source pointer.
limitations: No proposed fixture, 81-bit gate, expected status, runtime, memory bound, or component interval was numerically tested in this review.
Order-four preparation and candidate rounding can still fail; preserve failures and do not weaken frozen acceptance gates.
This design does not qualify public/default E6 dispatch or general kinematics, masses, derivative shapes, powers, or dimensions.
